subject: A first-time fund for the example sector
body:
Hello,

Your family office backs first-time managers, which is why I am writing. Example Fund is a pre-seed and seed fund for the example sector; the deck is here: https://example.org/decks/lp-deck

If a short call makes sense, you can book one here: https://calendar.example.org/book/sam

Does a first-time fund fit your allocation this year?

Best,
Sam Partner, Example Fund
